tasks.title: MISSING_EXIT_PRICE provenance recovery and replay safety
tasks.why: Unresolved exit prices previously conflated source gaps with verified no-bar outcomes and blocked ML readiness without a recoverable backlog.
tasks.resolution: Added hash-bound outcome evidence, vectorized recovery classification, explicit SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE backfill handling, CONFIRMED_NO_BAR structural exclusion, pinned readiness validation, and replay semantics that distinguish unfilled entries from unresolved filled exits without synthetic returns.
tasks.impact: ML snapshots now fail only for missing provenance/source gaps or selected unresolved filled vintages; verified no-bars remain auditable, backfill work is explicit, and MISSING_EXIT_PRICE cannot silently inflate or erase performance.

tasks.title: ML snapshot readiness and growth validation
tasks.why: Provisional ML runs showed positive Rank-IC but all policy paths were rejected by missing realized vintages, making no_trade a data-readiness verdict rather than an economic verdict.
tasks.resolution: Added vectorized outcome-readiness assessment, fail-closed training gate before OOF, certified-materialization rejection for incomplete outcomes, and regression coverage for unresolved, terminal-tail, and structural status cases.
tasks.impact: Prevents incomplete historical outcome data from contaminating policy selection; only repaired immutable snapshots can reach existing base/stress and untouched-holdout compounding promotion gates.

tasks.title: Bounded ML OOF memory
tasks.why: Six-horizon net-alpha discovery retains full per-horizon labels and calibrated OOF frames, driving measured peak RSS to 9648.812 MiB.
tasks.resolution: Register a sequential optimization blueprint: narrow horizon labels, temporary admitted-OOF Parquet spooling, deterministic cleanup, and max-RSS guardrails with unchanged fold/data contracts.
tasks.impact: Implementation target is lower peak RSS with bounded runtime overhead; no snapshot schema, label, fold, or model-selection contract changes.

tasks.title: Lightweight ML execution range
tasks.why: Research snapshot resolution rejected usable local ML/backtest data because unrelated evidence and costs ended before the feature window.
tasks.resolution: Added execution-mode snapshot resolution using the hash-bound base/features/labels overlap, bounded repository composition and cost loading to execution_range, and preserved strict full validation for paper/live modes.
tasks.impact: Local research ML and historical backtests no longer require excessive evidence coverage; point-in-time labels and no-imputation rules remain intact, while operational modes stay fail-closed.

tasks.title: Outcome backfill and unresolved-data handling
tasks.why: MISSING_EXIT_PRICE rows mixed recoverable API gaps with historical source-unavailable or no-bar outcomes, making ML and backtest readiness ambiguous.
tasks.resolution: Backfilled 2026-03-11 KRX opens, published immutable outcome evidence with SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE and CONFIRMED_NO_BAR distinctions, pinned evidence in snapshots, excluded unresolved outcomes from realized label arithmetic, and changed ML admission to use observed/active coverage gates.
tasks.impact: Recoverable exits are restored without imputation; non-recoverable history remains auditable and excluded from return arithmetic, while ML and replay avoid zero-fill and retain coverage diagnostics.

tasks.title: Deterministic multi-horizon Parquet validation
tasks.why: Multi-horizon label and outcome-status datasets failed closed because row ordering made stored and read-time content hashes disagree; every read also rehashed all decoded rows.
tasks.resolution: Canonical row hashing now uses a total ordered representation, partitioned reads compare declared manifest hashes and verify per-partition digests without a redundant full-table rehash, and identity output ordering includes horizon_sessions.
tasks.impact: Existing canonical ML label and status datasets are readable and tamper detection remains fail-closed with lower read overhead.

tasks.title: Stock outcome backfill and correct-use plan

tasks.resolution: Registered a fail-closed plan that pins outcome status in the snapshot, adds immutable KRX bar reconciliation, requires verified corporate-action settlement, and keeps unresolved outcomes out of realized arithmetic.
tasks.impact: Future ML/backtest runs can separate actual data collection gaps from non-recoverable or structural label failures; legacy snapshots remain diagnostic-only and all new artifacts retain hash-bound lineage.

tasks.title: ML realized-outcome integrity

tasks.impact: Prevents future-label selection bias and false cash/zero-fill evidence; enables future implementation to distinguish data coverage, evaluation structure, and replay logic while retaining auditable NO_TRADE results.

tasks.title: Selection-phase full-panel join OOM recovery
tasks.why: Post compounding-growth-v1, the 81-trial run died silently after trial 26 (h5 screen) inside _select_economic_champion. study_h5.db showed confirmation attrs written but selection/guard attrs absent; sync_run succeeded only because all_positive_finalists=0 skipped the finalist path. The 8fe74d4 _economic_transfer_evidence still did the full-panel join/group_by that ADR_20260814_STOCK_COMPOUNDING_TELEMETRY_OPT blamed for the screen-phase OOM.
tasks.resolution: Added _transfer_label_frame(panel, label_column) that projects to the four label columns before any duplicate-key check, so the full tuning panel is never group_by'd or re-materialized per finalist. Wired it into _economic_transfer_evidence (replacing _reject_duplicate_keys(panel) + inline panel.select) and into _select_economic_champion (compact frame built once, passed as panel= instead of tuning_panel). Output is byte-identical (projection preserves (session, instrument_id) 1:1).
tasks.impact: Removes the selection-phase OOM anti-pattern; the 81-trial run can now reach phase_selection and publish CAGR/MDD/DSR artifacts. Diagnostic parity preserved; gates/objectives/DSR multiplicity unchanged.

tasks.title: Fold telemetry memory recovery: compact labels join

tasks.resolution: Added _fold_transfer_attribution(scored, context.labels, label_column, top_k) and switched _score_trial_fold to join only the compact validation-scoped PreparedCandidateContext.labels (the same source _median_rank_ic uses), removing the full-panel 3-column projection. Telemetry schema, pooling, gates, and Optuna objective unchanged.

tasks.title: KIS 비용 증거와 유동성 슬리피지
tasks.why: 백테스트 비용이 정적 수수료·세율·슬리피지에 의존해 BanKIS 우대수수료 가정, 시행일별 매도세, 주문 유동성을 재현하지 못했다.
tasks.resolution: 비용 증거 로더와 해시 고정 계약, effective-dated KIS 비용, 매도세 분해, ADTV·변동성·호가단위 기반 슬리피지 및 simulator/backtester 연결을 추가했다.
tasks.impact: 비용 산출물은 snapshot에 고정되고 누락 입력은 fail-closed된다. 전체 연구 인증은 역사적 종목 master·DART·검증된 기업행동 증거가 complete가 될 때까지 provisional이다.

tasks.title: BanKIS cost schedule, statutory sell tax, and liquidity slippage
tasks.why: Backtests hardcoded 15bp commission, a single 23bp sell tax, and a fixed 5bp slippage, ignoring market/date/order liquidity.
tasks.resolution: Added a hash-bound counterfactual cost evidence artifact (BanKIS 0.0036396%/side, effective-dated statutory sell taxes per market, unified KRX tick table, sqrt-impact liquidity model), a fail-closed typed loader, and a shared fill-cost helper wired into both the backtest engine and the simulator; missing liquidity input fails orders closed as missing-liquidity-input and filled trades/manifests now trace artifact hash, commission, tax components, slippage, tick rule, and model parameter hashes.
tasks.impact: The engine and simulator resolve identical per-fill costs from one evidence artifact; research certification still requires the remaining evidence axes (historical master, full DART, verified actions) to be complete.

tasks.title: Stock research data foundation and provisional snapshot
tasks.why: Research and backtest inputs lacked one immutable catalog binding evidence, canonical panels, features, and labels.
tasks.resolution: Registered available evidence and immutable dataset versions, built provisional base/feature/label panels, created a hash-bound provisional snapshot, and verified bounded reads.
tasks.impact: Research can reproduce a provisional 2016-01-04..2026-03-03 snapshot without changing legacy or existing curated data; research certification remains blocked by incomplete historical evidence, verified corporate actions, and costs.

tasks.title: Resumable KRX calendar collection
tasks.why: One-shot date-by-date KRX calendar collection could block for hours and left no restartable artifact.
tasks.resolution: Added monthly atomic calendar partitions, resumable manifest validation, fail-closed merge, and explicit collection/merge CLI commands.
tasks.impact: Historical KRX session calendar collection can resume after API failures without repeating valid months; final calendars are emitted only after complete partition validation.

tasks.title: Stock evidence collection adapters
tasks.why: Evidence gates were implemented but authoritative KRX and OpenDART collection still needed a reproducible acquisition boundary.
tasks.resolution: Added KRX instrument/session collectors and OpenDART disclosure/corporate-action candidate collectors with raw receipt timestamps, candidate-only action status, validation tests, and verified sample artifacts.
tasks.impact: A bounded live collection path now supplies instrument identity and disclosure timing evidence; corporate-action adjustment remains fail-closed until effective dates and adjustment factors are independently verified.

tasks.title: Stock data quality hardening for research and backtest
tasks.why: Full source profiling exposed unclassified instruments, invalid OHLC rows, unexplained price discontinuities, missing disclosure availability, and historical coverage gaps that could invalidate strategy research.
tasks.resolution: Added effective-dated instrument classification, structural bar quarantine, KRX calendar and feature-availability gates, corporate-action interval validation, deterministic quality reports and lineage hashes, and backtest provenance checks.
tasks.impact: Provisional migrations remain auditable and non-promotable; research/production datasets now require explicit evidence before eligible rows can feed training, replay, paper, or live paths.

tasks.title: Canonical stock data curation and backtest readiness
tasks.why: Legacy feature partitions were not directly consumable by the modern point-in-time research and replay contracts, and filesystem paths needed to be independent of .env.
tasks.resolution: Added deterministic legacy-to-v2 curation with target separation, PIT timestamps, quality quarantine, manifest/content hashes, Hive-partitioned Parquet storage, tamper validation, repository-local data paths, and curate/train/simulate wiring.
tasks.impact: The existing data/processed/features source remains immutable and provisional; canonical data/curated/stocks is the required input for reproducible training and backtesting, while promotion/live remains fail-closed until lineage evidence is supplied.

tasks.title: Deterministic Korean equity trading cycle
tasks.why: The stock bounded context lacked a single point-in-time planner that connected certified data, promoted artifacts, constrained sizing, target-position intents, and parity backtesting.
tasks.resolution: Added a pure trading-cycle planner, certified dataset and promotion gates, content-based cycle fingerprints, deterministic return-volatility sizing with sector/ADTV/gross constraints and DE_RISK handling, target-position execution semantics, and event-driven replay parity.
tasks.impact: Paper/live paths remain fail-closed behind promotion and readiness evidence; backtests and paper planning share the same planner; task and code ownership are indexed for maintenance.

tasks.title: Quarantine invalid stock OHLC rows
tasks.why: Two legacy stock rows contain zero open/high/low values during documented trading-halt or partial-session events, so price backfill would fabricate tradable data.
tasks.resolution: The provisional legacy adapter now retains every row with deterministic data_quality_status and data_quality_reason fields; non-positive or missing OHLC rows are quarantined and research_eligible_frame excludes them from training and scoring.
tasks.impact: Source evidence remains auditable, invalid sessions cannot contaminate features, labels, or simulation, and future licensed backfills can replace quarantined rows with provenance.

tasks.title: Point-in-time Korean equity strategy research and compounding ledger
tasks.why: The stock research path mixed legacy feature provenance with incomplete temporal validation, one-shot simulation, and ambiguous promotion evidence.
tasks.resolution: Added deterministic provisional legacy-panel certification, point-in-time feature and label contracts, stable Rank-IC composite derivation, purged walk-forward promotion, constrained target weights, effective-dated costs, settlement-aware multi-session ledger, rebalance exits, and independent stress evaluation.
tasks.impact: Strategy results are reproducible and fail closed to NO_TRADE when out-of-sample evidence, cost stress, capacity, or ledger invariants do not pass; KIS live integration remains a later boundary.

tasks.title: Consolidate legacy/modern package duplication
tasks.why: The refactored tree still exposed duplicate etf/etfs roots and retained historical file layouts, reducing AI navigation efficiency and obscuring ownership.
tasks.resolution: Consolidated shared contracts under core/storage, organized stocks and ETFs by research/trading/backtesting/workflows, rebuilt execution around intents/orders/readiness, and quarantined historical implementations under src/legacy with parity coverage.
tasks.impact: Stock and ETF boundaries are explicit, legacy code is isolated, new ML/research components are replaceable, and the architecture remains extensible without reintroducing duplicate roots.

tasks.title: Separate stock and ETF architecture with replaceable ML
tasks.why: Historical stock YetiRank, ETF strategy, data processing, simulation, and unfinished execution paths were coupled and lacked explicit asset boundaries.
tasks.resolution: Introduced explicit core asset contracts, isolated stocks and etfs packages, point-in-time ML dataset/split/artifact boundaries, ETF parity fixtures, and paper-only execution gates; aligned filters tests and quality tooling with the migration boundary.
tasks.impact: Research and simulation paths are structurally separated; legacy modules remain excluded/read-only during migration, and live order submission remains gated.
